note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 4.3 ("However, a BGP speaker MUST be able to process UPDATE messages in this form." when the same prefix appears in WITHDRAWN ROUTES and NLRI). The single-polarity annotation is accurate: this MUST mandates accepting/processing the message shape without prescribing RIB winner (covered separately by RFC4271-4.3-7). TestSessionRFC4271SamePrefixWithdrawAndAnnounceIsProcessed sends initial ordinary, same-prefix mixed, and following ordinary UPDATEs over an established eBGP Session on net.Pipe, asserting ReadAndProcess succeeds, Established is kept, and one semantic UPDATE callback fires for each.
